mapper.select: SELECT GUEST_ID FROM ( SELECT GUEST_ID FROM GUEST_TB WHERE GUEST_ID LIKE 'GUEST' || #{today} || '%' ORDER BY GUEST_ID DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1
SELECT CASE WHEN QUANTITY >= #{quantity} THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END FROM PRODUCT_TB WHERE PRODUCT_NUMBER = #{productNumber}
SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS result FROM GUEST_CART_TB WHERE PRODUCT_NUMBER = #{productNumber} AND GUEST_ID = #{guestId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO GUEST_CART_TB (GUEST_ID, PRODUCT_NUMBER, QUANTITY, LAST_DATE) VALUES (#{guestId}, #{productNumber}, #{quantity}, #{lastDate})
INSERT INTO GUEST_CART_TB (GUEST_ID, PRODUCT_NUMBER, QUANTITY) VALUES (TRIM(UPPER(#{guestId})), TRIM(UPPER(#{productNumber})), #{quantity})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM GUEST_CART_TB WHERE GUEST_ID = #{guestId} AND PRODUCT_NUMBER = #{productNumber}
